title: Glitch lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Glitch templates were built and verified in: corrupted video title, scan-line news ticker, hacker alert, cyber sale, signal-lost end card, error 404 page, game over screen and chromatic logo sting (Screen-blended RGB copies).
use_when: You want to see a round-3 glitch template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a glitch film, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.

comps: GL News ticker (150 f, crawling headlines)
GL Chroma sting (90 f, Screen blend)

parameters: text content (sample copy: titles, handles, scores, codes and headlines are invented)
the lists in glitch_lab3.py (HEADLINES, BOLT) and the random seeds for block artefacts
the bolt mark (replace with your mark, three copies)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (gvt_, gnt_, gha_, gcs_, gse_, gnf_, ggo_, gcl_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/glitch_lab3.py writes the comps (cc.textw needs Pillow); every move is baked as Hold keys, no presets to apply and no masks; open the file and edit.save.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings (speed_jump info notes on the stepped jumps); qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
